answer: Every claim climbs the prism of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the inlet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The spiral of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
